title: Matchday 10: The College Football Opening Board
summary: A cautious top ten baseline: the current board, opening fixtures, and the uncertainty around both.
body: Matchday's first 2026 College Football Matchday 10 is a baseline, not a week-over-week movers list.
The current Top 25 supplies the order; scheduled opening fixtures provide the immediate context.
No opening fixture in the top ten has a market comparison or listed team absence in the current feed.

title: What We’re Refining Before We Count More Results
summary: How Matchday is tightening prediction locks, grading, calibration reporting, and MLB eligibility.
body: We are refining the proof around every reported prediction: pregame locks, like-for-like outcomes, market comparisons, and uncertainty metrics.
MLB is back in active coverage, but older rows without pregame lock evidence remain excluded from the official score.
The standard stays stable: no legacy mixing, no rewritten picks, and no improvement claim from accuracy alone.

title: Transparent Weekly Scorecard — July 19–25, 2026
summary: No verified locked pregame picks were eligible for the official score this week.
body: There is no official weekly score to celebrate or explain away: zero verified, locked pregame picks were eligible for the completed July 19–25 window.
One World Cup result and 66 graded MLB entries were excluded because their stored records lack pregame lock timestamps. No picks were rewritten and no legacy record was mixed into the official score.
Hits, misses, model-versus-market comparison, multiclass Brier, log loss, and calibration are not estimable at n=0.
